receipt.public_excerpt:
Requirements and obligations for general purpose AI systems laid down in Article 4b
shall not apply to micro, small and medium-sized enterprises.

evidence_items.explanation: The May 2022 proposal contains general-purpose AI duties in Article 4b and expressly exempts smaller enterprises from them. Proposed regulation therefore existed well before December 2023, although this does not date every provision in the eventual agreement.
